note: AHP over the attributes themselves: entities = the 1,010 Fable attribute definitions (data/ahp_attributes.txt, rubric tails stripped so the attribute is the thing judged, not a rubric); criteria = grant-goal framings (batteries/grant_goals.txt). Each goal is one --by pass; cardinal's IRLS solve of the sampled pairwise-ratio graph yields an importance weight vector over attributes for that goal. Composed with per-attribute polarity, this gives per-goal grant scores. budget is per goal (per --attributes line): 12000 comparisons over 1010 entities ~= 24/entity, enough for a connected, well-scaled estimate; raise budget or add seeds for tighter weights (more runway).
